name: Aino
notes: An off-field Hydro support. Her Burst DMG gains 50% of her EM, so EM is her scaling stat. Both sources agree on 4pc Silken Moon's Serenade and on EM main stats; KQM allows an ER Sands and an EM or Hydro DMG Goblet, Game8 wants EM on both, so the card lists EM first. Game8 puts Flame-Forged Insight first and KQM Favonius Greatsword, so the card takes Game8's weapon first and keeps the other as the second. Goals are Game8's upper ends; the ER goal is its 'double Hydro' range (110-130%), as Aino usually plays beside another Hydro character, and KQM's baseline without a weapon is 190-250%.
